label: Language Tree Hub
description: The center layer that turns English natural-language goals into subject scope, abstraction layer, association routes, context packs and validation tasks.

layers.label: Intent Layer
layers.purpose: Identify user goal, task type, done criteria and risk level.

layers.label: Lexicon Layer
layers.purpose: Maintain terms, aliases, multilingual mappings and subject ownership.

layers.label: Grammar Layer
layers.purpose: Identify operation structure, constraints, inputs, outputs and command shape.

layers.label: Semantic Abstraction Layer
layers.purpose: Raise local requests into reusable concepts, principles, methods or rules.

layers.label: Association Transfer Layer
layers.purpose: Search adjacent subjects, failure lessons and transferable methods by abstract similarity.

layers.label: Expression Layer
layers.purpose: Generate context packs, steps, instructions and user-readable summaries for agents.

layers.label: Validation Layer
layers.purpose: Write tests, tool results, human feedback and evidence back into route parameters.
